# POA in 30

> POA in 30 is a Dubai-based Power of Attorney service focused on bilingual POA drafting, remote notarization coordination, and electronic delivery. The site is available in English and Arabic.

## Arabic
Arabic equivalents use the same paths under https://www.poain30.ae/ar/ .

## Notes
Use the page dedicated to the specific transaction when available. Receiving-authority requirements can differ by transaction, document and authority; official legal-source links are shown on relevant pages.
